Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFPadesResult

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesResult
public final class CPDFPadesResult extends Object
Result of PAdES creation or LTV prolongation, including completed output stages.

Process success, target-profile satisfaction and individual validation checks are separate observations. A nonempty output path may remain available after a later failure. Use getFinalPath() to locate the last published stage and inspect getValidationResult() before accepting it.

Instances returned by SDK operations are read-only. Array getters return copies.

    • isTargetProfileSatisfied

      public boolean isTargetProfileSatisfied()
      Checks whether ordinary signature reports satisfy the operation's target profile.

      Requires process success, a known target, no run-level validation errors and at least one ordinary signature report. Each such report must contain a VALID pades.baseline_*.valid item for the target and must not be overall INVALID. For prolongation the target is LT or LTA according to the document-timestamp flag.

      Reports with SubFilter ETSI.RFC3161 are skipped by this helper. It relies on the core's profile items for document-timestamp dependencies; inspect the complete getValidationResult() and timestamp reports as well when accepting LTA output. This helper does not require every report to be overall VALID.

      Returns:
      true when the described target checks pass; false on failure, missing profile evidence or absent ordinary signatures
